properties.name: skystream.jetstream.enabled
properties.description: Whether to connect to Jetstream and ingest commits when the application starts.

properties.name: skystream.search.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable semantic search, which needs the embedding model in skystream.search.model-dir.

properties.name: skystream.search.model-dir
properties.description: Directory with embeddinggemma-300m's tokenizer.json and onnx/model.onnx (+ model.onnx_data), as fetched by scripts/fetch-model.sh.

properties.name: skystream.search.threads
properties.description: CPU threads the embedding model may use.
